title: grep
description: Lexical regex search over the task workspace via kernel-dispatched ripgrep (standalone-v1; ADR-0039 §10). Runs as a policy-classified process effect under the task sandbox profile with no shell, environment injection, network, or secrets. Returns bounded file:line:text matches and reports truncation with a continuation hint when the result set is capped.

pattern.description: Rust/ripgrep regular expression. Must not contain NUL.

path.description: Workspace-relative search root. Defaults to the workspace root.

glob.description: Optional include glob (ripgrep -g) to restrict searched files.

max_results.description: Maximum matches returned in the model-visible projection. Excess matches are reported as truncated with total_found.
